question: What does the operating system kernel actually depend on?

beats.speaker: interviewer
beats.line: What does the operating system kernel actually depend on?

beats.speaker: student
beats.line: The kernel depends on the scheduler to decide which process runs next.
beats.source_quote: it depends on the scheduler to decide which process runs next

beats.speaker: student
beats.line: It also depends on the device driver layer to move bytes to and from hardware.
beats.source_quote: it depends on the device driver layer to actually move bytes to and from hardware

beats.speaker: student
beats.line: These two dependencies are independent of each other, not of the kernel.
beats.source_quote: the two dependencies do not depend on each other, only on the kernel that calls them
